what: Hiring request with a man-day rate multiplies the day rate by months: 1 × ₹1,500 per man-day × 2 months is shown to the approver as ₹3,000 (list and banner). The requisition screen counts 22 days a month for the same basis (₹66,000).
rule: The approver must see the real commitment (hreq_commitment vs req_commercials disagree); docs/03 hiring request "Est. cost".

what: Requisition raised from a costing-based hiring request (2 people, 12 months) shows Commercial for 1 month only: Revenue ₹1.65 L, Cost ₹1.32 L, Profit ₹33,000 ("2 person(s) · 1.0 mo"), against the costing's ₹19,80,000 / ₹15,84,000 / ₹3,96,000. pc_requisition_from_hreq() does not pass the duration. The build-up shows ₹60,000/person·mo next to a ₹1.32 L total built from ₹66,000. Candidate "Placement commercials" estimate shows 0 mo / ₹0.
rule: docs/03 "The requisition raised from such a request takes the costing's rate, margin and cost build-up as its budget".

what: A Coordinator (no revenue or salary right) sees "Loaded cost 66,000, billed at 82,500 (20.0% margin)" and "Personnel / salary: 50,000" in the job description of a hiring request raised from a costing (also on requisition edit), and "billed at ₹82,500 per man-month" on the candidate's "Against the costing" box.
rule: docs/01 COORDINATOR must never see revenue/salary/profit; docs/02 fn 8 note "others see the margin verdict only".

what: Mumbai's "Possible duplicate" warning lists the Ahmedabad-locked EC Asha Patel with code REQ/AHM/…-CV01, mobile 9876543210, e-mail, stage, client TB Refinery Ltd and "Open →".
rule: docs/02 fn 8 (3): another office sees only the name and the badge in every list.

what: After Ahmedabad rejects a candidate, Mumbai cannot take him on: moving to its requisition needs a recruiter change, and the recruiter change is refused "ownership cannot be moved in this state" (rasg_state_ok refuses LOST candidates). Dead end, although the page says "link them to one of your own office's requisitions first (Edit → Requisition)".
rule: docs/02 fn 8 (5) and docs/03: after the process ends another office starts with them by linking them to its own requisition (owner point 9).

what: Salary structure built from CTC ₹6,00,000 per year with Approved budget 6,00,000 and Candidate expected 6,50,000 shows "Budget ₹6,00,000 · ₹-5,50,000" and "Candidate expected ₹6,50,000 · ₹-6,00,000": the monthly CTC is compared with yearly figures; the boxes carry no unit.
rule: Owner 11 Nov 2026: salary is per month with the year beside it (lib/recruit_offer.php:166); a variance must compare like with like.

what: Offer letter text prints "Your expected date of joining is 2026-12-01" (raw date) although the company date format is d M Y.
rule: Company setting date_format (set at setup "d M Y"); same kind as DEF-REC-033.

what: Test Coord (no data.salary) opens /offer-letter?id=1 and sees "₹50,000 a month (₹6,00,000 a year)", net ₹44,238 and the full per-month/per-year annexure, while the candidate page says "Compensation is restricted".
rule: docs/02 fn 8: salary figures only to can_see_salary(); docs/01 COORDINATOR must never see salary.

what: Branch Manager approves a DRAFT offer of ₹55,000/month (13.3% margin vs 20% target) directly; the margin reason required at Submit is never asked, and the offer is then issued (₹6,60,000 a year).
rule: Owner 9 Nov 2026 margin rule (docs/02 line 406: "needs a written reason, kept on the offer for the approver"); pack 23 A6 / DEF-REC-015.

what: Accepted (Hired) message ends "…you can now allocate deputations to them" although the new team record is PENDING_JOINING and only becomes schedulable at joining.
rule: docs/03: the hired person waits to join (PENDING_JOINING) and joining is the activation boundary.

what: Candidate saved with first name "" (empty) and with "   " (spaces only), and with experience −3 years. Known DEF-REC-007 / DEF-REC-008 (pack 23 B3, B11), not yet fixed.
rule: Pack 23 B3/B11 proposals; a candidate needs a name.

what: Coordinator sees the Budget column (₹66,000 loaded cost per person from the costing; ₹50,000) on the Requisition register.
rule: docs/01 COORDINATOR must never see salary/profit; data.salary = "See salary / loaded cost".

what: Delegation saved with From = 2027-02-29 (not a real date); shown as "2027-02-29 … Scheduled". Dates are shown as 2026-11-18 (known DEF-REC-033).
rule: Dates must be valid calendar dates; company date format d M Y.

what: Public careers page lists the costing-based opening as "Opening REQ/AHM/TBR/2611/C001/O002 📍 EC-QT-0001 · AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 00" — internal requisition, quotation and costing numbers shown to the public (designation is empty; project_site holds the refs).
rule: Careers page is public (docs/02 fn 8 Phase 7); internal commercial references must not be published.

what: The posting generator copies the costing text ("Personnel / salary: 50,000 … Loaded cost 66,000, billed at 82,500 (20.0% margin)") into Key responsibilities; saved as the public description it appears on /careers to anyone. Also text glitches "our our team", "looking for a Opening REQ/…".
rule: Salary and revenue are restricted figures (docs/02 data.salary / data.revenue); the careers page is public.

what: Test Coord2 (Mumbai) posts req_id of an Ahmedabad requisition to /jd-generate and receives its full posting text including "Loaded cost 66,000, billed at 82,500 (20.0% margin)". ops_jd_generate() checks only coordinator level and CSRF.
rule: Branch scope (docs/02 fn 8 M5 "requirements by scope_clause()"); requisition page refuses Mumbai.

what: Test Coord posts /candidate-commercial?id=4 (bill ₹82,500, cost ₹71,500, 12 months) → "Placement commercials approved", stored "Approved by Test Coord". The box is hidden from the Coordinator on screen; the route is gated only by is_coordinator_level().
rule: docs/01 COORDINATOR must never see revenue/profit; approving commercials is locking revenue.

what: Ahmedabad Coordinator reads Mumbai client TB Steel Works' contact (name, mobile 9000000000, e-mail) through /client-contacts?id=667, /partner-contact?id=667 (JSON) and the Customer 360 "Who to talk to" box, while the client page itself says contact details are withheld.
rule: docs/02 fn 5: another office gets BASIC and contact details are withheld.

what: Weekly hours −5 and 200, and weekly days 8, are saved as "Working norm saved." but stored as 48 hours / 6 days — the typed value is silently replaced.
rule: Brief/blueprint: a refused value must say why; a save must keep what was typed or refuse.

what: Offer decline accepted with an empty reason; candidate stage not moved to OFFER_DECLINED (stays RECEIVED, pipeline at Offer Letter), so the person stays "Locked — in recruitment with Ahmedabad" for Mumbai after the process ended. Related to known DEF-REC-011.
rule: docs/03: OFFER_DECLINED needs a reason and ends the process; the lock is lifted (owner 17 Nov point 9).
